title: A data editor for behavioral ecology
content: Like several other biology journals, Behavioural Ecology has now appointed a dedicated Data Editor. Although all manuscripts are required to include a Data Availability statement, and it has been a condition of publication that data are made available via Dryad (or other suitable public repository), there are some compelling reasons for us to take a more proactive approach to ensuring that the data used in each published study is accessible, complete, and usable.
